title: Forecast: Seasonal and dry Wednesday, rain returns on Friday
text:
Good morning and happy Wednesday! We are mild this morning with temperatures in the 60s. It will be another warm day with highs in the 80s. 80s continue the rest of the week with rain chances returning by Friday.
Forecast: Seasonal and dry Wednesday, rain returns on Friday
- Beth Finello, CBM - KOMU 8 Meteorologist
